claims.disproof_condition: 如果到 Open CPX 相容模組進入量產出貨時（以客戶具名 qualification 或公開出貨揭露為準），所有已知設計仍是 ELM、且沒有任何具名 ILM 產品達到 qualified/designed_in，則『規格允許』並不構成經濟上的替代，本 counter-path 應降級。核查頻率：每季（OFC／ECOC 展會與 Coherent／Lumentum 法說）。觸發後 48 小時內：把 tech:module_integrated_laser_source competes_with tech:external_laser_source 的 confidence 下修，並在 COHR thesis 記一筆 structural_score 的重算需求。
claims.statement: Open CPX Specification 1.0 defines the Internal-Laser Module (ILM), which uses a module-integrated laser source, as a first-class CPX module type with its own normative product codes (CPX-T1I / CPX-T2I) that intermates with the same Type-1/Type-2 sockets as the External-Laser Module; the specification nowhere requires an external laser source — every ELS obligation in it is scoped to 'For CPX ELMs'.

sources.quote: Figure 4-2 gives a functional description of an Internal-Laser Module (ILM) using a module-integrated laser source. Both ELM and ILM can intermate with Type-1 or Type-2 CPX sockets.

A module-integrated micro-controller (uC) shall provide a module management interface via CMIS as well as control pins… For CPX ELMs, the uC shall also provide interfacing to its associated ELS.
